known_limitations: The album page no longer shows its cover full-width; that was a deliberate choice of the owner (layout B).
The Downloads header is taller than before: on a short phone the first saved title starts below the fold.
Library and playlist rows keep their own layout (selection and reordering); only catalogue, artist, Local music and Replay use the shared row.
The artwork entry is a continuation of the page reveal, not a true shared element between two screens.
The Liquid 27 behaviours reproduce documented Liquid Glass behaviour; Apple does not publish its values.
The signing certificate is the existing public Android debug identity, not a private production key.
